evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 2.92 → 3.18 Torr from t=2520 to t=3240 with Ar flow steady at 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so rising pressure is not a flow change
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere/air ingress cannot be verified
Thermocouple tracks 750 °C setpoint with plausible heater power

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up / pump-down test with Ar off) to distinguish a seal leak admitting air from a partial exhaust blockage; also continued pressure trend to see if it plateaus.
